resolutions.researcher_notes: CONTRADICTS THE SHEET (flagging, not overwriting). Two independent phase-1-specific sources agree with each other at ~20 miles / ~32.2 km of new looping for Hillabee Phase 1 (NS Energy's itemized loop list: Proctor Creek 8.52km + Hissop 4.18km + Alexander City 12km + Billingsley 7.56km = 32.26km; Pipeline & Gas Journal's in-service notice: 'approximately 20 miles'), but the recorded LengthKnown is 35.41 km (= exactly 22.0 mi), a ~9% gap that is more than rounding (contract examples are ~1% gaps). The other three phase-1 sources checked (OGJ, World Pipelines, the 2014 Federal Register notice) only give whole-project totals — 43/43.5 miles across all three phases — not a phase-1-specific figure, so they cannot adjudicate this. Recommend Update/validity review of Length for sheet row 1394 against the ~20 mi / 32.2 km figure; not changing the value here per this leg's scope.

verifications.note: 'Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company, LLC (Transco)...filed an application under section 7(b) and 7(c) of the Natural Gas Act, requesting authorization to construct, own, and operate approximately 43.5 miles of pipeline looping facilities...(Hillabee Expansion Project)...' NGA section 7 authorization applies only to interstate natural gas transmission facilities — the regulatory basis for classifying this as a transmission pipeline. Already opened on this row for Operator/Owner/Proposal; re-read here for PipelineType.
